name: php-mcp-server-generator
Generate a production-ready PHP MCP server using the official PHP SDK. Ask for project name, description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, resources/prompts, and PHP version (8.2+).

Use PHP Attributes: `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`; strict types (`declare(strict_types=1);`) in all files; PSR-12; `#[Schema]` parameter validation; specific exceptions; PHPUnit tests for all tools; PHPDoc for all methods. Always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.

Commands: `php server.php`; `vendor/bin/phpunit`; `npx <REDACTED_USER>/inspector php server.php`. Client configuration: `"args": ["/absolute/path/to/server.php"]`.

Now generate the complete project based on user requirements!
